Name: Gifts from Your Beloved
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Another selection of gifts from your loved one.
Receive four more gifts for each new level of friendship with your spouse.
And that's not all! In case of divorce and remarriage, everything is ready for new gifts from your new spouse.

[b][size=4]✨ Features[/size][/b]

✔ Unique gifts for every friendship level
✔ Character-themed rewards
✔ Better and better gifts with each new level
✔ Fully lore-friendly gift selections
✔ Compatible with existing saves
✔ Gifts are reset when the mod is updated.

────────────────────────────────────
